event_id_policy: Permanent archive IDs are independent of season/card numbers.
source: Split from legacy archive/crypto-history/events.json without renumbering or dropping records.

events.title: Tesla announces $1.5bn Bitcoin purchase

research.summary: Tesla disclosed in its annual report that it had updated its investment policy in January and subsequently purchased an aggregate $1.5 billion of Bitcoin.
research.significance: The purchase was one of the most dramatic corporate endorsements of Bitcoin and helped push the corporate-treasury narrative into the global mainstream.

events.title: Beeple NFT sells for $69m

research.summary: Christie's sold Beeple's Everydays: The First 5000 Days for $69,346,250 in an online auction.
research.significance: The sale was the first purely digital NFT-based artwork offered by a major auction house and moved NFTs decisively into the traditional art world's mainstream.

events.title: Coinbase goes public

research.summary: Coinbase completed a direct listing of its Class A shares on Nasdaq under ticker COIN.
research.significance: The listing was the first major US crypto exchange to enter public equity markets at large scale and gave traditional investors direct exposure to a crypto-native business.

events.title: Dogecoin mania

research.summary: Dogecoin surged from a niche meme cryptocurrency into one of the largest crypto assets during a retail-speculation wave amplified by social media and repeated Elon Musk commentary.
research.significance: The 2021 DOGE mania established meme coins as a major crypto market category rather than a one-off joke.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin and Elon Musk's SNL appearance

events.title: China mining crackdown

research.summary: China's Financial Stability and Development Committee explicitly called for a crackdown on Bitcoin mining and trading on 21 May, followed by provincial shutdowns that sharply reduced domestic mining activity.
research.significance: The crackdown forced the largest geographic redistribution of Bitcoin mining in the network's history and ended China's prior dominance in measured mining activity.

sources.title: Reuters — China orders crackdown on Bitcoin mining and trading
Cambridge CCAF — Bitcoin mining map historical findings

events.title: El Salvador Bitcoin legal-tender law takes effect

research.summary: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law came into force on 7 September 2021.
research.significance: The effective date transformed the June legislation into a live nationwide legal-tender system and made Bitcoin acceptance, convertibility infrastructure and government wallet rollout a real-world policy experiment.

sources.title: IMF — El Salvador 2021 Article IV mission

events.title: Ethereum London upgrade / EIP-1559

research.summary: Ethereum's London upgrade activated at block 12,965,000 and introduced EIP-1559, replacing the old fee auction with a base-fee mechanism that burns part of transaction fees.
research.significance: EIP-1559 fundamentally changed Ethereum's fee market and ETH issuance economics, laying groundwork for the post-Merge monetary system.

events.title: Bored Ape Yacht Club launches

research.summary: Bored Ape Yacht Club opened a week-long presale on 23 April 2021 at 0.08 ETH per Ape; after a slow first week, the remaining collection sold out on 1 May.
research.significance: BAYC transformed the profile-picture NFT into a membership, brand and community model that became one of the defining symbols of the 2021 NFT boom.

sources.title: Yuga Labs — Let's Make A NFT

events.title: China intensifies restrictions on cryptocurrency trading

research.summary: The People's Bank of China and multiple state agencies declared virtual-currency-related business activities illegal financial activities and tightened enforcement against overseas exchanges serving Chinese residents.
research.significance: This was a separate nationwide trading/enforcement escalation after the mining crackdown.

sources.title: PBOC and agencies — virtual-currency trading-risk notice

events.title: Poly Network exploit becomes famous for the return of stolen funds

research.summary: An attacker stole about $612 million across Poly Network on 10 August; beginning the next day, the attacker returned most of the assets and communicated through on-chain messages.
research.significance: It was then the largest DeFi theft and became uniquely famous because the attacker returned nearly all of the stolen crypto.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Poly Network hack and returned funds

events.title: Axie Infinity and play-to-earn explode

research.summary: Axie Infinity grew from tens of thousands of daily users early in 2021 to hundreds of thousands by July while its player-owned economy expanded rapidly.
research.significance: Axie became the flagship play-to-earn game and showed that NFT ownership and token incentives could support large online labor/guild economies.

events.title: ConstitutionDAO attempts to buy a copy of the US Constitution

research.summary: ConstitutionDAO raised tens of millions of dollars from internet contributors in an attempt to buy a rare first printing of the US Constitution at Sotheby's, but lost the auction.
research.significance: The episode demonstrated how quickly a DAO could coordinate capital and culture around a shared goal, even though it failed to acquire the artifact.

events.title: Bitcoin reaches roughly $69,000

research.summary: Bitcoin reached a new all-time high around $69,000 on 10 November 2021, with the exact high varying by exchange and price index.
research.significance: The peak marked the top of Bitcoin's 2020–2021 bull cycle before the prolonged 2022 crypto downturn.
research.notes: Use the exact price from the chosen index/exchange in published copy.

events.title: El Salvador passes the Bitcoin Law

research.summary: El Salvador's Legislative Assembly approved Decree No. 57, the Bitcoin Law, establishing Bitcoin as legal tender alongside the US dollar.
research.significance: El Salvador became the first sovereign state to legislate Bitcoin as legal tender, creating an unprecedented national crypto experiment.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — 2021 decrees, Decree 57 Bitcoin Law
IMF — El Salvador 2021 Article IV mission

events.title: Nigeria launches the eNaira CBDC

research.summary: Nigeria formally launched the eNaira central-bank digital currency.
research.significance: The eNaira was among the earliest national retail CBDCs and represented a government-controlled digital-money path distinct from permissionless crypto.

sources.title: Central Bank of Nigeria — eNaira launch release

events.title: OpenSea becomes a defining marketplace of the NFT boom

research.summary: OpenSea became the dominant marketplace of the first mass NFT boom, with the company later reporting that transaction volume grew more than 600-fold during 2021.
research.significance: The marketplace became the primary consumer venue through which millions encountered NFT collections and secondary trading.

events.title: Art Blocks helps push generative NFT art into the mainstream

research.summary: Art Blocks, launched in late 2020 with Chromie Squiggle as project #0, became one of the most influential platforms of the 2021 generative-art boom.
research.significance: It established long-form on-chain generative art as a major NFT art category.

events.title: Facebook rebrands to Meta amid metaverse mania

research.summary: Facebook changed its corporate name to Meta and explicitly centered its future strategy on building the metaverse.
research.significance: The rebrand pushed 'metaverse' from crypto/NFT subculture into global corporate and media vocabulary and intensified virtual-land and metaverse-token speculation.

events.title: Crypto.com Arena naming becomes a symbol of exchange-era marketing

research.summary: The former Staples Center officially became Crypto.com Arena on Christmas Day 2021; exterior signage continued being replaced into 2022.
research.significance: The naming deal became one of the biggest symbols of crypto companies buying mainstream sports visibility.

sources.title: Crypto.com / AEG — Crypto.com Arena naming agreement

events.title: Vitalik Buterin donates large quantities of meme tokens to charity

research.summary: Vitalik Buterin transferred more than 50 trillion SHIB, then valued at roughly $1 billion, to India's Crypto-Covid Relief Fund and also donated other meme tokens and crypto to charitable organizations.
research.significance: The donation turned unsolicited meme-token holdings into one of crypto's largest high-profile charitable gifts and created a real liquidity challenge for the recipient.

sources.title: India Crypto Relief — SHIB donation accounting

events.title: NFT profile-picture culture becomes a mainstream crypto identity phenomenon

research.summary: Profile-picture NFT collections such as CryptoPunks, Bored Ape Yacht Club and Pudgy Penguins became visible social-identity markers across crypto communities during 2021.
research.significance: PFP culture turned NFT ownership into public online identity and status, helping drive the mass NFT boom.

events.title: Uniswap V3 introduces concentrated liquidity

research.summary: Uniswap v3 launched on Ethereum mainnet with concentrated liquidity and multiple fee tiers.
research.significance: Concentrated liquidity dramatically increased capital efficiency and reshaped automated market maker design across DeFi.

events.title: Arbitrum mainnet opens a major optimistic-rollup era

research.summary: Arbitrum One opened publicly on 31 August 2021.
research.significance: Its launch marked the beginning of large-scale production optimistic-rollup usage and made Ethereum Layer 2 a major live ecosystem rather than mainly research.

sources.title: Arbitrum — history noting Aug 31 2021 public launch

events.title: Optimism launches its optimistic rollup mainnet

research.summary: Optimism deployed OP Mainnet in January 2021 in a restricted form, initially onboarding selected applications before later removing the deployment whitelist.
research.significance: Optimism was one of the first production optimistic-rollup networks and helped establish Ethereum Layer 2 as a major scaling category.

events.title: Solana suffers a major network outage during rapid growth

research.summary: Solana stopped producing confirmed blocks for roughly 17 hours after bot transaction load contributed to validator failures and loss of consensus.
research.significance: The outage became the most prominent early reliability failure of a high-throughput alternative Layer 1 during its rapid adoption phase.

events.title: Terra UST and LUNA ecosystem expands rapidly

research.summary: Terra's UST stablecoin and LUNA ecosystem expanded rapidly during 2021 as Anchor deposits and applications grew.
research.significance: This is a build-up era node essential to understanding the 2022 death spiral, not a single launch event.

events.title: Anchor Protocol high stablecoin yield becomes central to Terra growth

research.summary: Anchor Protocol launched on Terra in March 2021 and offered UST deposit yields targeted around 20%, funded by borrower interest, staking yield and later reserve support.
research.significance: Anchor became the principal demand engine for UST and therefore a central piece of the system whose failure would amplify Terra's 2022 collapse.

events.title: OlympusDAO popularizes protocol-owned liquidity and 3,3 culture

research.summary: Olympus distributed alphaOHM through its initial community launch and began migration to OHM on 23 March, the date the project later described as its official launch.
research.significance: Olympus popularized protocol-owned liquidity, extremely high staking yields and the '(3,3)' coordination meme, becoming a defining experiment of the 'DeFi 2.0' period.

events.title: ENS airdrop rewards early Ethereum naming users

research.summary: ENS token claiming opened on 8 November for eligible .eth name holders based on the 31 October snapshot, launching ENS DAO governance.
research.significance: The retroactive airdrop rewarded identity-system users and became another influential example of converting protocol users into token governors.

sources.title: ENS Docs — ENS token and airdrop

events.title: Visa buys a CryptoPunk

research.summary: Visa purchased CryptoPunk #7610 for 49.5 ETH, roughly $150,000 at the time.
research.significance: A global payments company buying a CryptoPunk was a highly visible sign that NFTs had entered corporate and institutional culture.

sources.title: Visa — metaverse/NFT article referencing 2021 CryptoPunk purchase

events.title: Squid Game-themed token collapses in a publicized rug-pull episode

research.summary: The unaffiliated SQUID token, themed around Netflix's Squid Game, collapsed from a briefly quoted price above $2,800 to near zero after a spectacular late-October rally. Contemporary reporting described wallet activity consistent with a rug pull, while Reuters said it could not independently verify every allegation.
research.significance: The episode became a textbook meme-token scam story and a warning about unaffiliated branding, illiquid tokens and sell restrictions.
research.notes: Do not state an exact stolen amount as settled fact; contemporary estimates varied.

events.title: Colonial Pipeline ransomware payment puts Bitcoin tracing in spotlight

research.summary: DarkSide ransomware disrupted Colonial Pipeline in May and received a Bitcoin ransom; on 7 June the US Department of Justice announced seizure of 63.7 BTC from the payment.
research.significance: The case connected cryptocurrency, critical infrastructure, ransomware and blockchain tracing in a single globally visible event.

sources.title: US DOJ — Colonial Pipeline ransom recovery

events.title: Vitalik Buterin donates large quantities of meme tokens to charity

research.summary: This is the same Vitalik Buterin meme-token charity event as LORE-EVT-0182.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0182.

sources.title: India Crypto Relief — SHIB donation accounting

events.title: NFT profile-picture culture becomes a mainstream crypto identity phenomenon

research.summary: This is the same NFT profile-picture culture trend represented by LORE-EVT-0189.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0189.

events.title: Tesla begins accepting Bitcoin for vehicle purchases

research.summary: Tesla began accepting Bitcoin as payment for vehicles in the United States and said Bitcoin received would be retained rather than immediately converted to fiat.
research.significance: A major manufacturer accepting Bitcoin for a high-value consumer product was a landmark merchant-adoption moment.

sources.title: Reuters — Tesla accepts Bitcoin for vehicles

events.title: Tesla suspends Bitcoin vehicle payments over environmental concerns

research.summary: Tesla suspended Bitcoin vehicle purchases, with Elon Musk citing concerns about fossil-fuel use in Bitcoin mining.
research.significance: The reversal pushed Bitcoin's energy use into mainstream environmental debate and showed the market influence of a single corporate endorsement.

sources.title: Reuters — Tesla suspends Bitcoin car payments

events.title: NBA Top Shot helps take NFTs mainstream

research.summary: By late March 2021, Dapper Labs said NBA Top Shot had generated about $500 million in sales and registered more than 800,000 accounts since its October 2020 public beta.
research.significance: Top Shot turned licensed sports highlights into one of the first mass-market NFT collecting experiences and helped introduce NFTs to mainstream sports fans.

sources.title: NBA.com — Dapper Labs / NBA Top Shot March 2021

events.title: Bitcoin Taproot activates

research.summary: Bitcoin's Taproot soft fork activated at block 709,632.
research.significance: Taproot added Schnorr signatures and new scripting/privacy efficiencies, representing Bitcoin's most significant protocol upgrade since SegWit.

sources.title: Bitcoin Optech — Taproot activated at block 709,632

events.title: El Salvador launches Chivo wallet and Bitcoin rollout

research.summary: The government launched the Chivo wallet alongside the Bitcoin Law, including a $30 equivalent incentive for eligible users.
research.significance: Chivo was the operational layer of El Salvador's legal-tender rollout and a key measure of real-world adoption.

sources.title: IMF — El Salvador 2021 Article IV mission

events.title: PancakeSwap becomes a major retail DEX

research.summary: PancakeSwap surpassed roughly $1 billion in project value and reported about $1.92 billion in 24-hour trading volume on 19 February 2021, overtaking Uniswap on that daily-volume snapshot.
research.significance: PancakeSwap became the signature retail DEX of BNB Smart Chain and demonstrated that DeFi activity could scale rapidly outside Ethereum.

sources.title: Binance — PancakeSwap reaches leading DEX volume in Feb 2021

events.title: Iron Finance stablecoin collapse becomes a high-profile failure

research.summary: IRON Finance suffered an algorithmic stablecoin run as TITAN collapsed from roughly $60 toward zero within hours and IRON lost its dollar peg.
research.significance: The collapse was an early large-scale warning that reflexive partially collateralized stablecoin designs could unwind catastrophically under a run.

sources.title: Federal Reserve — Runs on Algorithmic Stablecoins

events.title: Crypto.com buys naming rights to Staples Center

research.summary: AEG and Crypto.com announced a 20-year naming-rights deal to rename Staples Center as Crypto.com Arena, with the new name unveiled on Christmas Day.
research.significance: The agreement became one of the most visible symbols of peak-cycle crypto marketing and exchange sponsorship.

events.title: Visa settles a transaction using USDC on Ethereum

research.summary: Visa announced that it had settled a transaction in USDC over Ethereum with Crypto.com as a pilot partner.
research.significance: A global card network using a public blockchain stablecoin in treasury settlement was a landmark bridge between crypto rails and traditional payments.

sources.title: Visa — first USDC settlement over Ethereum

events.title: Decentraland virtual land sells for record $2.4M during metaverse boom

research.summary: A Decentraland land parcel sold for about $2.4 million worth of cryptocurrency, then a record for virtual real estate on the platform.
research.significance: The sale captured the peak of 2021 metaverse land speculation after Facebook's Meta rebrand.

events.title: Canada approves major spot Bitcoin ETFs

research.summary: Purpose Bitcoin ETF began trading in Canada with direct holdings of physical Bitcoin, marketed as the world's first Bitcoin ETF of its type.
research.significance: Canada delivered regulated spot Bitcoin ETF exposure years before US spot products were approved.

sources.title: Purpose Bitcoin ETF brochure — inception Feb 18 2021

events.title: China declares crypto-related transactions illegal

research.summary: This is the same September 2021 Chinese virtual-currency business prohibition represented by LORE-EVT-0117.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0117.

sources.title: PBOC and agencies — virtual-currency trading-risk notice

events.title: Nigeria restricts banks from servicing crypto businesses

research.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria directed regulated banks and other financial institutions to stop providing services to cryptocurrency exchanges and to close accounts of persons or entities involved in cryptocurrency transactions.
research.significance: The directive became one of Africa's most consequential crypto-banking restrictions and pushed more Nigerian activity toward peer-to-peer channels.

sources.title: Central Bank of Nigeria — Feb 2021 crypto banking restriction

events.title: South Korea exchange registration rules reshape domestic market

research.summary: South Korea's VASP registration deadline took effect under amended financial-transaction law, forcing crypto businesses to register and imposing additional conditions on fiat-serving exchanges.
research.significance: The regime consolidated the Korean exchange market and became a major example of regulation reshaping national crypto-market structure.

sources.title: South Korea FSC — VASP registration deadline status
South Korea FSC — VASP registration obligation

events.title: Swiss DLT Act reforms enter into force

research.summary: Parts of Switzerland's DLT legal reform enabling ledger-based securities took effect on 1 February, and the remaining DLT Act and ordinance — including the DLT trading-facility regime — took full effect on 1 August 2021.
research.significance: Switzerland created one of the world's earliest comprehensive statutory frameworks tailored to tokenized securities and DLT market infrastructure.

sources.title: Swiss Federal Council — DLT Act fully in force

events.title: MiamiCoin experiment links municipal branding and crypto

research.summary: CityCoins launched MiamiCoin mining on the Stacks network on 3 August 2021, with a mechanism that could direct a share of protocol value to a city-controlled wallet if the city chose to claim it.
research.significance: MiamiCoin became one of the highest-profile experiments linking municipal branding, Bitcoin-adjacent smart contracts and community-issued tokens.

events.title: Nigeria launches eNaira CBDC

research.summary: This is the same eNaira launch as LORE-EVT-0152.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0152.

sources.title: Central Bank of Nigeria — eNaira launch release

events.title: First US Bitcoin futures ETF begins trading

research.summary: ProShares Bitcoin Strategy ETF (BITO) began trading as the first US Bitcoin-linked ETF, using Bitcoin futures rather than holding spot Bitcoin.
research.significance: BITO ended years of failed US ETF attempts but also highlighted the distinction between futures-based exposure and the later spot Bitcoin ETP era.

events.title: Thodex exchange collapses in Turkey

research.summary: Thodex users lost access to the Turkish exchange as operations stopped; prosecutors confirmed founder Faruk Fatih Özer left Turkey on 20 April and opened a criminal investigation on 22 April.
research.significance: The collapse became one of Turkey's largest and most notorious crypto-exchange scandals and led to an international manhunt.

sources.title: Istanbul Anadolu Chief Public Prosecutor — Thodex investigation
Istanbul Anadolu Chief Public Prosecutor — Thodex founder left Turkey

events.title: Cream Finance suffers repeated DeFi exploits

research.summary: C.R.E.A.M. Finance's Ethereum v1 markets were exploited on 27 October 2021 in a large flash-loan-related attack; the protocol later published a postmortem and repayment plan.
research.significance: The incident capped a run of CREAM exploits and illustrated the compounding security risks of highly composable DeFi lending markets.

events.title: Helium hotspot network expands rapidly during 2021

research.summary: Helium's community-built wireless network expanded rapidly during 2021: an academic measurement found roughly 20,000 connected hotspots in March and 44,000 by late May, while the Helium Foundation later described the network as having started 2021 near 15,000 hotspots.
research.significance: The expansion made Helium one of the most visible early DePIN-style crypto networks.

sources.title: Helium Foundation — 2022 Protocol Report with 2021 growth baseline

events.title: THORChain suffers repeated exploits

research.summary: THORChain suffered two major back-to-back Ethereum-router exploits in July 2021 that tricked its Bifrost system into crediting assets that had not actually been received.
research.significance: The attacks forced a prolonged shutdown and major security redesign for one of the earliest native cross-chain liquidity protocols.

events.title: Polkadot parachain auctions begin

research.summary: Polkadot's first batch of parachain auctions began on 11 November 2021; Acala won the first auction on 18 November, and the initial winners were onboarded in December.
research.significance: The auctions operationalized Polkadot's shared-security model by allocating scarce relay-chain slots to independent parachains.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Polkadot parachain auctions begin Nov 11
CoinDesk — Acala wins first Polkadot parachain auction

events.title: Avalanche Rush incentives accelerate ecosystem growth

research.summary: The Avalanche Foundation announced Avalanche Rush, a $180 million liquidity-mining incentive program initially designed to bring Aave and Curve to Avalanche.
research.significance: The program accelerated the multichain DeFi race and helped Avalanche become a major alternative smart-contract ecosystem.

events.title: StarkEx powers major ZK-based applications

research.summary: StarkEx powered production applications such as dYdX's Layer 2 perpetuals system during 2021.
research.significance: This is infrastructure context for the dYdX/StarkWare deployment and the wider rise of ZK-based scaling.

events.title: dYdX grows as a major decentralized perpetuals venue

research.summary: dYdX and StarkWare launched a Layer 2 protocol for cross-margined perpetual trading using StarkEx.
research.significance: The move demonstrated that zero-knowledge scaling could support high-volume non-custodial derivatives trading with lower costs and no per-trade gas.

events.title: MEV sandwich attacks become widely discussed user risk

research.summary: Flashbots' 2021 reports documented rising miner-extractable value activity, including sandwiching, bot competition and growing miner participation in MEV extraction.
research.significance: MEV moved from a specialist research topic into a major Ethereum user-experience, market-structure and protocol-design problem.

events.title: Lido becomes dominant Ethereum liquid-staking infrastructure

research.summary: Lido's liquid-staking system grew rapidly during 2021, reaching hundreds of millions of dollars of value within months and expanding to additional proof-of-stake networks.
research.significance: Lido made staked ETH liquid and composable in DeFi, helping create the liquid-staking-token category that would become central after the Merge.
research.notes: This is an adoption/growth row; Lido itself launched in late 2020.

events.title: GameStop-style retail speculation spills into Dogecoin

research.summary: Retail trading enthusiasm around GameStop and other meme stocks overlapped with renewed speculative attention on Dogecoin.
research.significance: This is contextual background to the broader Dogecoin mania rather than a discrete crypto protocol event.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin and Elon Musk's SNL appearance

events.title: Dogecoin reaches a tens-of-billions market value

research.summary: By early May 2021 Dogecoin's market capitalization had risen into the tens of billions of dollars.
research.significance: The scale demonstrated that internet meme culture could become a major crypto market force.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin and Elon Musk's SNL appearance

events.title: Elon Musk's Dogecoin posts repeatedly move markets

research.summary: Elon Musk's public Dogecoin comments repeatedly became major market and media events during DOGE's 2021 rise.
research.significance: This is a recurring culture/market pattern rather than one event; the SNL appearance is the cleanest canonical moment.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin and Elon Musk's SNL appearance

events.title: SNL Dogecoin episode becomes a peak meme-coin culture moment

research.summary: Elon Musk hosted Saturday Night Live during the peak of 2021 Dogecoin speculation; DOGE fell sharply during and after the broadcast after enormous anticipation.
research.significance: The episode was the clearest crossover of meme-coin speculation, celebrity influence and mainstream television culture.

sources.title: Reuters — Dogecoin and Elon Musk's SNL appearance

events.title: SHIB token frenzy expands the meme-coin category

research.summary: Shiba Inu surged into the ten largest crypto assets by market capitalization, briefly overtaking Dogecoin with a reported market value around $42 billion.
research.significance: SHIB demonstrated that meme-coin culture had expanded beyond Dogecoin into a repeatable speculative category.

sources.title: Reuters — Shiba Inu enters crypto top 10

events.title: OpenSea raises major venture rounds during NFT boom

research.summary: OpenSea announced a $100 million Series B led by Andreessen Horowitz during the accelerating NFT boom.
research.significance: The funding round reflected the extraordinary speed with which NFT marketplace infrastructure became a major venture category.

events.title: BAYC secondary sales explode and celebrity adoption rises

research.summary: Bored Ape Yacht Club moved from a fast-selling PFP collection into a high-value secondary and auction market; Sotheby's sold a lot of 101 Bored Apes for $24.4 million in September 2021.
research.significance: The auction-market expansion demonstrated BAYC's shift from internet collectible to globally recognized luxury/status asset.

events.title: Art Blocks Chromie Squiggle becomes a generative-art icon

research.summary: Chromie Squiggle served as Art Blocks project #0 and became the platform's signature generative work as the market expanded in 2021.
research.significance: It is a strong art-history card candidate, but its launch belongs to Art Blocks' 2020 origin rather than being a new 2021 event.

events.title: Loot launches as text-only NFT primitives

research.summary: Dom Hofmann launched Loot as 8,000 free-to-mint NFTs containing only randomized lists of fantasy-adventure equipment, deliberately omitting images, stats and a predefined game.
research.significance: Loot inverted the conventional NFT model by giving the community primitives rather than a finished world, spawning a burst of derivative projects and bottom-up worldbuilding.

events.title: Axie Infinity token economics support large player guilds

research.summary: Axie's AXS/SLP economy, breeding and guild structures became core parts of the game's rapid user growth.
research.significance: Token-economy context belongs under the broader Axie/play-to-earn story rather than being treated as a separate launch.

sources.title: Axie Infinity — roadmap and completed milestones

events.title: Ronin sidechain supports Axie's rapid expansion

research.summary: Axie Infinity launched Ronin mainnet, its Ethereum-linked sidechain designed specifically for the game.
research.significance: Ronin removed much of the transaction-cost friction that had constrained Axie's growth and enabled the later play-to-earn explosion.

events.title: Avalanche reaches major DeFi adoption

research.summary: Avalanche's DeFi adoption accelerated after the Avalanche Rush incentive program and major protocol deployments.
research.significance: This adoption trend belongs under the canonical Avalanche Rush event rather than being scored separately.

events.title: Fantom DeFi ecosystem grows rapidly

research.summary: The Fantom Foundation announced a 370 million FTM incentive program for protocols deploying on Fantom, allocating rewards based on sustained TVL.
research.significance: The incentive program accelerated Fantom's 2021 DeFi expansion and exemplified the cross-chain liquidity-incentive competition of the period.

events.title: Terra LUNA reaches top-tier market capitalization

research.summary: LUNA rose into the top tier of crypto market capitalization during Terra's 2021 expansion.
research.significance: Keep as market context, but attach a defined market-cap source/date before publication.

events.title: FTX acquires naming rights to Miami Heat arena

research.summary: Miami-Dade County approved a 19-year, $135 million naming-rights agreement with FTX.US for the county-owned Miami Heat arena, later branded FTX Arena.
research.significance: The arena deal became one of the most visible symbols of FTX's rapid mainstream expansion—and, after 2022, of how quickly that image unraveled.

sources.title: Miami-Dade County — FTX Arena naming-rights agreement

events.title: FTX signs major sports and celebrity partnerships

research.summary: FTX expanded aggressively into sports and celebrity marketing, including its MLB partnership and other large sponsorship deals.
research.significance: The marketing blitz became part of FTX's pre-collapse public image and later one of the starkest symbols of the 2021 excess cycle.

events.title: Kraken removes Monero for UK customers

research.summary: Kraken ceased Monero trading and new deposits for UK customers on 26 November 2021, not 2022, citing UK regulatory compliance.
research.significance: The delisting is a useful early example of exchange access narrowing for privacy coins.

sources.title: Monero Observer — Kraken UK Monero support ends

events.title: Poly Network exploit crosses multiple chains

research.summary: Poly Network's exploit crossed Ethereum, BSC and Polygon-related assets as part of the same $612 million theft.
research.significance: Technical context under the canonical Poly Network hack.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Poly Network hack and returned funds

events.title: ENS names become part of Crypto Twitter identity

research.summary: ENS names increasingly appeared in social-media identities and brand profiles during the NFT/Web3 boom; the official ENS community later highlighted major accounts using .eth names and Budweiser's 2021 beer.eth purchase.
research.significance: ENS became more than an address resolver: .eth names evolved into visible Web3 identity markers.

sources.title: ENS Docs — ENS token and 2021 airdrop
ENS DAO newsletter — ENS names in Twitter identities / Budweiser

events.title: Gitcoin community transitions toward DAO governance

research.summary: Gitcoin introduced the GTC governance token and GitcoinDAO on 25 May 2021, distributing governance to the community around its open-source funding ecosystem.
research.significance: The move converted one of Ethereum's best-known public-goods funding projects into a token-governed DAO.

events.title: Nouns DAO begins daily on-chain NFT auctions

research.summary: Nouns DAO's daily-auction model is already captured in the canonical Nouns launch record LORE-EVT-1134.
research.significance: Avoid double-counting the same DAO/NFT innovation.

events.title: PleasrDAO buys the original Doge meme NFT

research.summary: PleasrDAO won the auction for the original Doge meme NFT for 1,696.9 ETH, roughly $4 million at the time.
research.significance: The purchase transformed one of the internet's most recognizable memes into a multi-million-dollar on-chain cultural artifact owned by a DAO.

sources.title: Own The Doge — Doge NFT history

events.title: FreeRossDAO raises funds around Ross Ulbricht NFT auction

research.summary: FreeRossDAO won Ross Ulbricht's Genesis Collection NFT auction for 1,446 ETH after more than a thousand contributors pooled funds.
research.significance: The event combined DAO fundraising, NFT ownership, prison-reform advocacy and one of Bitcoin history's most controversial figures.

sources.title: SuperRare — Ross Ulbricht Genesis Collection sale

events.title: ConstitutionDAO issues PEOPLE token after failed auction

research.summary: After losing the auction, ConstitutionDAO said it would wind down and enable contributors to redeem the PEOPLE token for ETH, while PEOPLE continued trading.
research.significance: The token's afterlife became an unexpected example of community assets surviving the organization that created them.

events.title: DeFi TVL reaches record roughly $178B

research.summary: DeFiLlama's historical data places aggregate DeFi TVL at an all-time high of roughly $177.6 billion on 9 November 2021.
research.significance: The record quantified the extraordinary scale DeFi reached during the 2021 bull market.

sources.title: DefiLlama — historical DeFi TVL cycle analysis

events.title: Raydium becomes a major Solana DEX

research.summary: Raydium publicly introduced its Solana-based AMM on 20 February 2021, integrating liquidity with Serum's central-limit order book.
research.significance: Raydium became a central liquidity venue during Solana's first major DeFi expansion.

events.title: Magic Eden launches and becomes a major Solana NFT marketplace

research.summary: Magic Eden launched in September 2021 as a Solana NFT marketplace.
research.significance: It quickly became a central marketplace for Solana NFTs and a major non-Ethereum competitor in NFT trading.

events.title: Cardano Alonzo enables smart contracts

research.summary: Cardano's Alonzo hard fork activated Plutus smart-contract functionality on mainnet.
research.significance: Alonzo turned Cardano from a staking/native-asset network into a smart-contract platform capable of hosting dapps.

events.title: Cardano Mary enables native assets

research.summary: Cardano's Mary hard fork activated native multi-asset functionality.
research.significance: Mary allowed users to create custom tokens directly on Cardano without requiring smart contracts.

events.title: Polkadot parachain slot auctions start

research.summary: This is the same first Polkadot parachain-auction sequence represented by LORE-EVT-0392.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0392.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Polkadot parachain auctions begin Nov 11

events.title: Cosmos IBC launches cross-chain communication

research.summary: Cosmos Hub completed the Stargate upgrade, enabling the Inter-Blockchain Communication protocol on the Hub.
research.significance: IBC made standardized sovereign-chain interoperability a live capability and realized a core piece of the Cosmos 'internet of blockchains' vision.

sources.title: Cosmos Hub Forum — Stargate mainnet upgrade

events.title: MicroStrategy hosts Bitcoin for Corporations conference

research.summary: MicroStrategy hosted its Bitcoin for Corporations program in 2021, sharing treasury, legal, accounting and operational material intended to help other companies evaluate Bitcoin.
research.significance: The event turned MicroStrategy's own treasury strategy into an explicit corporate adoption playbook.

events.title: Tesla Bitcoin purchase triggers corporate-treasury speculation

research.summary: Tesla's Bitcoin purchase triggered intense speculation that other large corporations might copy the treasury strategy.
research.significance: Market/culture consequence of the canonical Tesla purchase.

events.title: El Salvador's president announces Bitcoin law at Bitcoin conference

research.summary: El Salvador President Nayib Bukele announced by video at the Bitcoin 2021 conference in Miami that he would send legislation to make Bitcoin legal tender.
research.significance: The announcement was the public reveal of the world's first sovereign Bitcoin legal-tender plan, three days before the legislature passed the law.

sources.title: Reuters — Bukele announces planned Bitcoin legal-tender bill at Bitcoin 2021

events.title: Bitcoin 2021 Miami becomes a defining bull-market conference

research.summary: Bitcoin 2021 brought a large concentration of Bitcoin companies, advocates and public figures to Miami and became the stage for El Salvador's legal-tender announcement.
research.significance: The conference became a defining cultural event of Bitcoin's 2021 institutional/bull-market phase.

sources.title: Reuters — Bukele announces planned Bitcoin legal-tender bill at Bitcoin 2021

events.title: Laser-eyes profile pictures spread across Bitcoin Twitter

research.summary: The #LaserRayUntil100K profile-picture campaign began on Bitcoin Twitter, with users adding glowing laser eyes to avatars until Bitcoin reached $100,000.
research.significance: Laser eyes became one of Bitcoin's most visible social identity memes and spread to executives, politicians and eventually a head of state.

events.title: Michael Saylor's Bitcoin evangelism becomes internet culture

research.summary: Michael Saylor used MicroStrategy's Bitcoin for Corporations event and repeated public appearances to promote Bitcoin treasury adoption to corporate executives.
research.significance: His advocacy became a defining part of institutional Bitcoin culture after MicroStrategy's 2020 treasury move.

events.title: NFT avatars become status symbols on Twitter

research.summary: NFT avatars becoming status symbols on social media is the same wider PFP identity trend represented by LORE-EVT-0189.
research.significance: Keep as social/cultural context rather than a competing card event.

events.title: Beeple appears on major mainstream television after NFT sale

research.summary: Beeple became a mainstream media figure after the Christie's sale, appearing across television and traditional art coverage.
research.significance: This is a cultural consequence of the $69.3 million sale, not yet a strong standalone event; keep it under the canonical Beeple sale unless a specific broadcast becomes card-worthy.

events.title: CryptoPunk sells for multi-million-dollar sums

research.summary: CryptoPunk #7523, the 'Covid Alien,' sold at Sotheby's for $11.8 million.
research.significance: The sale set a then-record auction price for a single CryptoPunk and helped establish Punks as blue-chip digital collectibles within traditional auction markets.

events.title: Mutant Ape Yacht Club launches and expands the BAYC ecosystem

research.summary: Yuga Labs launched Mutant Ape Yacht Club through a serum airdrop to BAYC holders and a Dutch auction for additional Mutant Apes.
research.significance: MAYC doubled the broader Ape ecosystem and demonstrated how a successful NFT collection could expand into a persistent franchise.

sources.title: BAYC — Mutant Ape Yacht Club launch

events.title: Pudgy Penguins launches

research.summary: Pudgy Penguins minted on 22 July 2021; the 8,888-piece collection sold out in under 20 minutes at 0.03 ETH each.
research.significance: The collection became a major PFP brand and later one of the most successful examples of an NFT project expanding into consumer products.

events.title: Cool Cats launches during PFP boom

research.summary: Cool Cats was first released on-chain on 1 July 2021.
research.significance: Cool Cats became one of the recognizable profile-picture projects of the 2021 NFT boom and a useful marker of how rapidly PFP culture diversified beyond CryptoPunks and BAYC.

events.title: Loot derivatives explode despite minimal original artwork

research.summary: Loot rapidly inspired derivative art, games, rarity systems and other community-built projects.
research.significance: This is the cultural aftermath of the canonical Loot launch.

events.title: VeeFriends links NFTs to Gary Vaynerchuk events

research.summary: VeeFriends Series 1 launched on 11 May 2021 with 10,255 NFTs created by Gary Vaynerchuk, combining collectible characters with access and utility tied to the VeeCon event ecosystem.
research.significance: VeeFriends became one of the clearest examples of a mainstream entrepreneur using NFTs as access passes and community membership rather than only digital art.

events.title: Gary Vaynerchuk becomes a major mainstream NFT promoter

research.summary: Gary Vaynerchuk became one of the most visible mainstream promoters of NFTs while launching and marketing VeeFriends.
research.significance: This is founder/culture context for the canonical VeeFriends launch rather than a separate historical event.

events.title: FTX valuation rises rapidly through major venture rounds

research.summary: FTX closed a $900 million Series B financing round that valued the exchange at $18 billion.
research.significance: The record-scale funding round captured FTX's extraordinary pre-collapse ascent and the level of institutional venture confidence behind it.

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried testifies before US House on digital assets

research.summary: FTX co-founder and CEO Sam Bankman-Fried testified before the US House Financial Services Committee at a hearing on digital assets and financial innovation.
research.significance: The testimony marked FTX's and Bankman-Fried's growing visibility in US policy debates less than a year before the exchange collapsed.

sources.title: US House — Sam Bankman-Fried testimony, Dec. 8 2021

events.title: FTX.US expands sports sponsorships

research.summary: FTX.US expanded aggressively into sports sponsorships, including the Miami arena deal, MLB partnership and an August naming-rights agreement for the field at California Memorial Stadium paid in cryptocurrency.
research.significance: The sponsorship wave became a defining visual marker of FTX's rapid mainstream rise before its 2022 collapse.

events.title: Celsius advertises high yields as safer than banks

research.summary: Celsius marketed itself as a high-yield alternative to traditional banks. Later FTC and CFTC actions alleged that Celsius and its leadership made misleading claims about safety, risk and leverage; the CFTC cited specific 2021 public statements.
research.significance: The contrast between the marketing message and the later collapse is central to the CeFi credit-boom story.

sources.title: CFTC complaint — Celsius marketing and risk claims

research.notes: Attribute allegations and findings to regulators; avoid independently characterizing intent beyond established legal outcomes.

events.title: BlockFi expands athlete sponsorships, including Cade Cunningham

research.summary: The archive's 'naming rights' wording could not be substantiated. BlockFi did, however, sign a multi-year partnership with NBA No. 1 draft pick Cade Cunningham and paid his signing bonus in Bitcoin.
research.significance: This is evidence of the 2021 crypto-sports sponsorship boom, but it is weaker than FTX/Crypto.com arena naming deals.

events.title: Three Arrows Capital becomes major leveraged crypto fund

research.summary: Three Arrows Capital was a large crypto hedge fund using extensive borrowing and leverage, but the strongest official evidence quantifying its borrowing concerns 2022 rather than a single 2021 milestone.
research.significance: Retain as precursor context for the 2022 contagion story, not as a scored 2021 card until a precise 2021 event is sourced.

sources.title: SEC order — Genesis lending and Three Arrows Capital exposure

events.title: Genesis crypto lending originations surge to $131B in 2021

research.summary: Genesis reported $131 billion of loan originations during 2021, nearly seven times its 2020 total, and ended the year with $12.5 billion of active loans outstanding.
research.significance: The growth illustrates the enormous institutional crypto-credit expansion that preceded the 2022 deleveraging crisis.

events.title: GBTC discount emerges after years of premium trading

research.summary: GBTC began trading at a discount to net asset value for the first time in late February 2021 after years of premium trading; by May the discount had exceeded 20%.
research.significance: The reversal broke a highly profitable institutional arbitrage trade and became an important precursor to later leverage and credit stress.

sources.title: The Block — GBTC begins trading at a discount in 2021

events.title: SEC permits first US Bitcoin futures ETF

research.summary: Regulatory non-objection/approval mechanics allowed the first US Bitcoin futures ETF to proceed.
research.significance: Canonicalize the user-visible milestone to BITO's trading launch unless a specific SEC procedural event is separately needed.

events.title: ProShares BITO launches with record-setting ETF demand

research.summary: This is the same ProShares BITO launch as LORE-EVT-0358.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0358.

events.title: Coinbase debuts NFT marketplace plans during NFT mania

research.summary: Coinbase announced Coinbase NFT and opened an early-access waitlist for a planned peer-to-peer NFT marketplace.
research.significance: The announcement showed a major regulated exchange attempting to expand directly into the consumer NFT boom.

events.title: Stefan Thomas reports only a few password attempts remain for 7002 BTC

research.summary: Programmer Stefan Thomas publicly described having only two password attempts left on an IronKey containing access to 7,002 BTC after eight failed guesses.
research.significance: The story became one of crypto's most vivid self-custody and lost-key cautionary tales.

sources.title: The Guardian — Stefan Thomas has two password guesses left

events.title: James Howells proposes high-tech landfill search for lost Bitcoin

research.summary: James Howells continued campaigning for permission to excavate a Newport landfill in search of the discarded hard drive he says held access to thousands of BTC, proposing increasingly elaborate recovery plans.
research.significance: The decades-long recovery effort turned the lost-hard-drive story into enduring Bitcoin folklore about irreversible self-custody mistakes.

sources.title: CBS News — James Howells landfill recovery campaign

events.title: NBA Top Shot queues and pack drops become mainstream NFT culture

research.summary: NBA Top Shot's limited pack drops and long online queues became a defining part of its early-2021 collector culture.
research.significance: This is cultural context around Top Shot's mainstream breakout rather than a separate protocol event.

sources.title: NBA.com — Dapper Labs / NBA Top Shot March 2021

events.title: Sorare expands fantasy-sports NFTs

research.summary: Sorare announced a $680 million Series B at a $4.3 billion valuation while operating an NFT fantasy-football platform with partnerships spanning major clubs and leagues.
research.significance: The raise made sports NFTs one of the clearest mainstream consumer use cases of the 2021 NFT boom.

sources.title: Sorare — $680M Series B and sports NFT expansion

events.title: Adidas enters NFT market

research.summary: adidas announced its Into the Metaverse Web3/NFT project on 16 December and the first NFT sale followed on 17 December.
research.significance: It was one of the clearest entries by a major global apparel brand into crypto-native NFT culture.

events.title: Nike acquires RTFKT

research.summary: Nike acquired RTFKT, the digital-fashion and NFT studio.
research.significance: The acquisition was one of the clearest examples of a global consumer brand buying directly into a crypto-native NFT/metaverse company.

events.title: Budweiser buys an ENS name and NFT imagery

research.summary: Budweiser purchased the ENS name beer.eth for 30 ETH and used NFT imagery on its social profile.
research.significance: The move became an early example of a global consumer brand treating an ENS name and NFT identity as marketing assets.

sources.title: ENS DAO newsletter — Budweiser purchased beer.eth in Aug. 2021

events.title: Visa purchase of CryptoPunk signals institutional NFT curiosity

events.title: Sotheby's and Christie's expand crypto-native digital art auctions

research.significance: Traditional auction houses embracing NFTs was a major institutional-art-market validation of crypto-native digital ownership.

events.title: XCOPY's Right-click and Save As guy sells for about $7M

sources.title: Artnet — XCOPY Right-click and Save As guy sale

events.title: Crypto.com becomes Formula 1 global partner

research.summary: Formula 1 announced Crypto.com as a global partner and inaugural partner of its new Sprint series.
research.significance: The partnership placed a crypto exchange brand across one of the world's most global sports during the peak sponsorship boom.

events.title: FTX sponsors Major League Baseball umpires

research.summary: Major League Baseball and FTX announced a global partnership on 23 June 2021; MLB umpires began wearing FTX patches at the All-Star Game in July.
research.significance: The umpire patches became one of the most visually distinctive examples of peak-cycle crypto sports sponsorship.

events.title: Tezos becomes prominent in sports sponsorships

research.summary: Tezos signed prominent motorsport partnerships in 2021, including with Red Bull Racing and McLaren Racing, which used Tezos for NFT fan experiences.
research.significance: The partnerships made Tezos particularly visible in the wave of blockchain sports sponsorships.

sources.title: McLaren — 2021 Tezos partnership and NFT platform

events.title: Kazakhstan becomes a major destination for displaced Chinese miners

research.summary: Cambridge data showed Kazakhstan accounting for about 18.1% of measured global Bitcoin hashrate by August 2021, up sharply as mining power migrated after China's crackdown.
research.significance: Kazakhstan became one of the clearest destinations in Bitcoin's historic post-China mining migration before later energy and policy pressures reduced its role.

sources.title: Cambridge CCAF — geographic shift in Bitcoin mining

events.title: Texas emerges as a major Bitcoin mining hub

research.summary: The United States became the largest measured Bitcoin-mining jurisdiction after China's crackdown, while large Texas facilities such as Riot's Whinstone expanded rapidly.
research.significance: Texas emerged as a symbolic and industrial center of the US mining migration because of large-scale power access and mining investment.

sources.title: Cambridge CCAF — geographic shift in Bitcoin mining

events.title: WAGMI and NGMI become dominant crypto social vocabulary

research.summary: WAGMI ('we're all gonna make it') and NGMI ('not gonna make it') became widely used crypto and NFT community slang during the 2021 boom.
research.significance: The language is culturally important, but there is no clean single origin event in the current evidence set; keep as glossary/book context rather than scoreable history.

events.title: Probably nothing becomes NFT Twitter shorthand

research.summary: 'Probably nothing' became a recurring ironic phrase in NFT/Crypto Twitter for developments that users actually considered significant.
research.significance: Useful culture glossary material, but not a discrete verifiable event.

events.title: Right-click save-as becomes an NFT culture-war meme

research.summary: The 'right-click save' criticism of NFT ownership became a common culture-war meme; XCOPY's artwork Right-click and Save As guy embodied the argument and then sold for millions in December 2021.
research.significance: The meme is best represented through the specific XCOPY sale rather than a separate unsourced trend card.

sources.title: Artnet — XCOPY Right-click and Save As guy sale

events.title: Vitalik burns billions of dollars worth of donated SHIB tokens

research.significance: The burn removed a huge fraction of SHIB's supply and became a foundational piece of Shiba Inu lore.
research.notes: Exact token quantity should be taken from the indexed on-chain transfer when used in card copy.

events.title: SBF testifies publicly and promotes crypto regulation proposals

research.summary: Sam Bankman-Fried testified before the U.S. House Committee on Financial Services alongside executives from Circle, Coinbase, Paxos, Stellar and Bitfury in a hearing on digital assets and financial innovation.
research.significance: The hearing represented the crypto industry's growing direct engagement with US federal policymakers before FTX's collapse the following year.

sources.title: US House Financial Services — Digital Assets hearing

events.title: Gemini Earn expands retail crypto lending

research.summary: Gemini launched Gemini Earn, allowing customers to lend supported crypto assets and earn advertised yields of up to 7.4% APY.
research.significance: Gemini Earn became a prominent example of retail CeFi yield products and later a central piece of the Genesis/Gemini contagion dispute.

events.title: Coinbase direct listing makes employees and investors publicly liquid

research.summary: Coinbase employees and shareholders gained public-market liquidity through the direct listing.
research.significance: This is a consequence of the canonical Coinbase listing.

events.title: FreeRossDAO buys Ulbricht artwork NFT

research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0603.

events.title: Colonial Pipeline ransom is partially recovered by US authorities

research.summary: US authorities announced recovery of 63.7 BTC, then worth about $2.3 million, from the Colonial Pipeline ransom.
research.significance: The recovery showed that Bitcoin's public ledger and law-enforcement seizure mechanisms could undermine the idea that crypto ransom payments were untraceable.

sources.title: US DOJ — Colonial Pipeline ransom recovery

events.title: Thodex founder disappears after exchange halts withdrawals

research.summary: Thodex founder Faruk Fatih Özer left Turkey shortly before the exchange became inaccessible, prompting an international search.
research.significance: The disappearance is a human/crime subevent of the canonical Thodex collapse.

sources.title: Istanbul Anadolu Chief Public Prosecutor — Thodex founder left Turkey

events.title: Africrypt founders disappear amid disputed missing-funds claims

research.summary: Lawyers representing Africrypt investors told Reuters that client funds worth billions of dollars were missing and the two brothers who ran the South African platform could not be traced. Reuters explicitly noted that the claimed loss had not been independently confirmed.
research.significance: Africrypt became one of crypto's biggest alleged missing-funds mysteries, but the scale of the loss must remain qualified.

sources.title: Reuters — Africrypt founders cannot be traced after disputed missing funds

research.notes: Always describe the multibillion-dollar figure as an investor-lawyer claim, not independently verified fact.

events.title: Poly Network attacker communicates through on-chain messages

research.summary: The Poly Network attacker used transaction metadata to communicate publicly while returning funds.
research.significance: The on-chain conversation is one of the strangest pieces of hack culture in crypto history.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Poly Network hack and returned funds

events.title: Bitcoin conference culture expands around Miami events

research.summary: The expansion of Bitcoin conference culture in Miami is represented by the canonical Bitcoin 2021 event.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0761.

events.title: Discord becomes core infrastructure for NFT communities

research.summary: Discord became a primary community, support and coordination platform for NFT projects and marketplaces during the 2021 boom.
research.significance: That centrality made Discord part of NFT culture but also created a major social-engineering attack surface.

sources.title: BleepingComputer — Discord malware targets crypto/NFT communities

events.title: Discord hacks become major NFT theft vector

research.summary: Attackers increasingly targeted NFT and crypto Discord communities through fake support accounts, phishing links and malware; OpenSea users were publicly targeted in August and broader malware campaigns were documented later in the year.
research.significance: Discord compromise and phishing became a defining NFT security risk.

sources.title: BleepingComputer — Discord malware targets crypto/NFT communities

events.title: MetaMask reaches tens of millions of monthly users

research.summary: Consensys announced that MetaMask had surpassed 21 million monthly active users.
research.significance: The milestone showed that a self-custodial Web3 wallet had reached mass consumer scale during the DeFi and NFT boom.

events.title: Phantom wallet launches for Solana users

research.summary: Phantom formed in January 2021 and launched its Solana wallet during 2021, becoming one of the ecosystem's main consumer gateways.
research.significance: Phantom gave Solana a polished self-custody wallet comparable to MetaMask's role on Ethereum and became central to Solana DeFi and NFTs.
research.notes: Exact first public-beta day is not asserted because the current primary sources establish the year and launch sequence more clearly than a single date.

events.title: CowSwap introduces batch auctions and MEV-aware trading

research.summary: Gnosis announced Gnosis Protocol v2 and made CowSwap available as a proof-of-concept trading interface using batch auctions and solver-based execution designed to reduce MEV.
research.significance: CowSwap helped pioneer intent-like trading and MEV-aware batch-auction execution that later evolved into CoW Protocol.

sources.title: Gnosis — Introducing Gnosis Protocol V2 and CowSwap

events.title: Aave launches on multiple networks

research.summary: Aave went live on Polygon in April 2021, followed by liquidity-mining incentives that drove rapid growth in deposits and borrowing.
research.significance: The deployment showed how leading Ethereum DeFi protocols could expand to lower-cost networks and became one of Aave's first major multi-chain successes.

events.title: Maker adds real-world asset collateral

research.summary: Centrifuge's New Silver pool became MakerDAO's first live real-world-asset collateral integration, receiving a $5 million debt ceiling and minting DAI backed by real-world loans.
research.significance: This was a major step from purely crypto-backed DeFi toward tokenized real-world credit and later on-chain Treasury markets.

sources.title: Centrifuge — first MakerDAO real-world asset onboarding

events.title: Arbitrum One launches

research.summary: This is the same Arbitrum One public launch as LORE-EVT-0233.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0233.

sources.title: Arbitrum — history noting Aug 31 2021 public launch

events.title: Optimism removes whitelist restrictions

research.summary: Optimism removed its deployment whitelist in December 2021, allowing anyone to deploy contracts without prior approval.
research.significance: Permissionless deployment marked Optimism's transition from a controlled launch phase into an open Ethereum Layer 2 platform.

events.title: Yield Guild Games formalizes play-to-earn guild model

research.summary: Yield Guild Games conducted its public YGG token sale on 27 July 2021, with YGG serving as the utility and membership token for the guild's DAO.
research.significance: YGG formalized the large-scale play-to-earn guild model that pooled NFT game assets and organized global player communities.

sources.title: Yield Guild Games — YGG Token Sale

events.title: Axie Infinity daily active users explode

research.summary: Axie Infinity reported more than 800,000 daily active users in July 2021.
research.significance: The growth made Axie the most visible proof that blockchain games could reach a large global daily audience.

events.title: Axie scholarships become a source of income in emerging markets

research.summary: Axie scholarship arrangements allowed asset owners and gaming guilds to lend teams to players in exchange for a share of earned tokens, becoming especially visible in lower-income markets.
research.significance: The scholarship model was a defining social/economic feature of play-to-earn, but a single card should use a specific documented guild or adoption milestone.

events.title: Immutable X launches as NFT and gaming scaling network

research.summary: Immutable X launched its mainnet alpha as an Ethereum layer-2 focused on NFTs, offering gas-free minting and trading while retaining user custody.
research.significance: It became one of the earliest dedicated NFT scaling networks and important gaming infrastructure.

sources.title: Immutable — Immutable X mainnet alpha launch

events.title: Gala Games expands blockchain gaming ecosystem

research.summary: Gala Games expanded its decentralized gaming ecosystem and node network during 2021, adding games and game-specific node plans.
research.significance: The growth made Gala a notable example of tokenized gaming infrastructure, though this row is an era trend rather than one discrete launch.

events.title: Maker governance votes increasingly control protocol risk parameters

research.summary: Maker governance continued actively managing collateral, risk and protocol parameters as Dai and real-world-asset exposure expanded.
research.significance: This is important DAO governance context but not one standalone 2021 event; individual Maker votes make better canonical milestones.

events.title: Compound governance bug distributes excess COMP

research.summary: Compound Proposal 62 executed with a bug that allowed some users to claim excess COMP from the Comptroller contract; later governance proposals constrained and repaired the distribution logic.
research.significance: The incident showed that even mature DeFi governance upgrades could introduce economically significant smart-contract errors.

events.title: Nouns DAO introduces one-auction-per-day treasury governance

research.summary: Nouns DAO's first daily NFT auction settled on 8 August 2021; the protocol was designed to auction one new Noun every 24 hours and route proceeds directly into a DAO-controlled treasury.
research.significance: Nouns created a distinctive self-funding DAO/brand model in which NFT sales continuously capitalized a public treasury governed by holders.

events.title: Multichain expands from Anyswap into multi-chain bridge leader

research.summary: Anyswap began its transition and rebranding to Multichain, with ANY-to-MULTI token conversion opening on 17 December 2021.
research.significance: The rebrand reflected the project's expansion from a cross-chain swap product into one of the largest multi-chain bridge infrastructures of the period.

events.title: Hop Protocol develops Ethereum rollup bridge infrastructure

research.summary: Hop Protocol publicly launched its first production bridge, beginning with USDC transfers between Ethereum and rollups.
research.significance: Hop became early infrastructure for moving assets rapidly across Ethereum Layer 2 networks without waiting for native withdrawal periods.

events.title: Across Protocol launches L2-to-L1 bridge

research.summary: Across Protocol publicly launched its bridge for fast transfers between Ethereum Layer 2 networks and Ethereum mainnet using relayers and an optimistic-oracle security model.
research.significance: Across became an important bridge design in the later shift toward intent- and relayer-based cross-chain transfers.

events.title: Hydra dominates Russian-language darknet commerce

research.summary: US law-enforcement analysis later estimated that Hydra accounted for roughly 80% of darknet-market-related cryptocurrency transactions in 2021.
research.significance: Hydra's scale made it the dominant Russian-language darknet market before its 2022 international seizure.

sources.title: US DOJ — Hydra accounted for estimated 80% of darknet crypto transactions in 2021

events.title: OpenSea adds massive numbers of first-time NFT traders

research.summary: OpenSea welcomed very large numbers of new collectors during the NFT boom.
research.significance: User-growth context belongs under OpenSea's broader 2021 marketplace expansion.

research.significance: Meebits extended the CryptoPunks lineage from 2D profile pictures toward interoperable 3D avatars and metaverse identity.

events.title: Punks Comic experiments with NFT-native storytelling

research.summary: Pixel Vault launched PUNKS Comic Issue #1 on 10 May 2021, using characters inspired by specific CryptoPunks and building an NFT-native narrative universe.
research.significance: It was an early experiment in turning PFP intellectual property into serialized storytelling and a broader media franchise.

sources.title: Pixel Vault — PUNKS Comic anniversary / May 10 2021 launch

events.title: Binance faces coordinated regulatory warnings in multiple countries

research.summary: Regulators in multiple jurisdictions issued warnings or restrictions involving Binance in 2021; Japan's FSA warned Binance on 25 June for operating without registration and the UK's FCA imposed restrictions on Binance Markets Limited on 26 June.
research.significance: The cluster of regulatory actions marked a major shift from Binance's hypergrowth era toward sustained jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction compliance pressure.

sources.title: FCA — consumer warning on Binance Markets Limited

research.notes: Phrase carefully by legal entity and jurisdiction; do not imply every warning applied identically to Binance.com globally.
